{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Filter out rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure)
df_clean = df_dedup[df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 3: Correct assay_batch B: divide biomarker_final by 10 (since 1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL)
df_clean.loc[df_clean['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Step 4: Compute response rate per site
response_rates = df_clean.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)

# Print results
print(response_rates)"}
